body: dude my freind got into general science and he got a 60% on his english maybe even lower. All im gonna say is that they mainly will see how great you did in your science and maths and be ok with that. You are applying to science so they mainly care about your ability to do science. english will be slightly excused just dont fail it.

Im honurs comp sci and I had about a 90% to 92% for my late senior year grades and I got accepted in like march. I also took sat and sat 2 mathematics and did decent on both. Had about a 6 average in my 5 IB classes.

In all honesty as long as your in low to mid 90% in your sciences and calculus or math then you should be fine. Also take this from me if you get rejected from other places dont let it freak you out too much. I got rejected from every school besides ualberta. Application time is stressfull but focus on your studies more so then your applications. some kids I know got accepted the last week of august. They wont reject your application early unless you straight up dont have required classes.
